about: Röstprofiler. voiceId fylls i först när rösten har valts och provlyssnats (null = ej vald; skriptet vägrar då att generera tal). ElevenLabs standardröster ('default'/'premade') upphör 2026-12-31 och finns bara för konton skapade före mars 2026: välj en röst ur Voice Library eller skapa en egen med Voice Design. Redan genererade filer påverkas inte när en röst försvinner.

adult-operator.character: English-speaking radio operator guiding a lone survivor through a dangerous zone. Clear, controlled, calm under pressure, slightly raspy. Short, clipped radio phrasing. Never theatrical or shouting, except a firmer tone on urgent lines.
adult-operator.librarySearch: middle-aged male, American or British, gravelly or raspy, calm, authoritative, military, radio, narration; use case: characters/video games
adult-operator.voiceDesignPrompt: A middle-aged male radio operator with a calm, controlled and slightly raspy voice, neutral American accent, speaking clearly and concisely over a field radio, steady and reassuring but serious.
adult-operator.postProcess: Valfritt: radiofilter (bandpass ca 300–3400 Hz, lätt distorsion) läggs på lokalt efter godkännande, eller i appen med Web Audio. Generera alltid ett rent original.

mini-narrator.character: Friendly English-speaking storyteller for children aged about 6–10. Warm, clear diction, positive energy, playful but never shrill or sarcastic. Slightly slower than normal speech.
mini-narrator.librarySearch: young adult or adult, female or male, warm, friendly, cheerful, clear, children's storyteller, animation; use case: characters/children's content
mini-narrator.voiceDesignPrompt: A warm, cheerful young adult storyteller voice for a children's adventure game, clear pronunciation, gentle enthusiasm, smiling tone, neutral accent, never shrill.
